versions.changelog:
tiaozhanbei-datiao 1.0.0

- Initial release as a participant guidance assistant for the "挑战杯" extracurricular academic science and technology competition.
- Offers end-to-end assistance: competition overview, project categorization, and evaluation dimension interpretation.
- Provides targeted suggestions for project preparation across all three major judging criteria.
- Integrates with pptx skill to generate professional, competition-standard PPTs for entry projects.
- Includes templates and structured frameworks for all major project types.
- Supports information collection and workflow guidance for new participants.
